provenance: Transcribed verbatim from RI-CMB01 §B as REBASED by ARBITRATION seam S22 (wave 0, task rebase-s22). Every frame column is doubled from the pre-rebase table; the pre-rebase values are kept in `was_pre_s22` so the diff stays visible and so a build that accidentally implements the old ladder is caught by inspection as well as by measurement.
seam_S23: RI-CMB01 owns EVERYTHING the equip-load tier does inside the fight — tier boundaries, i-frames, roll distance, recovery. RI-PRG07 owns out-of-fight encumbrance and may keep finer granularity there provided it has NO in-fight effect. On any in-fight disagreement RI-CMB01's number stands. This file is the in-fight table.
tier_boundary_rule: Cliffs, never ramps. load <= 30.00 -> LIGHT; 30.01..70.00 -> MEDIUM; 70.01..100.00 -> HEAVY; > 100.00 -> OVERLOADED. Any interpolation of an i-frame count across a boundary is a defect (RI-CMB01 M5).
evaluated: once, on the frame of the press, from carried_equipment_weight / max_equip_load. Changing gear mid-roll cannot change the roll in flight (RI-CMB01 C8).

recovery_substructure._source: RI-CMB09 §2. Recovery is not one undifferentiated block.
rules: HARD: no input has any effect, yaw is locked to the roll direction, the hurtbox is fully active.
TURN: yaw may change at 240 deg/s. No translation, no action.
BUFFER: one action may be latched and fires on the first actionable frame. Overlaps TURN.
The hurtbox during recovery is the STANDING hurtbox, restored on the first recovery frame — not the low rolling hurtbox held to the end of the clip (RI-CMB09 M3).
Recovery is measured to the first ACTIONABLE frame, not to the end of the animation clip.

binding_rules.C1: Invulnerability is a frame window, never a flag with a timer. The sim asks 'is anim_frame in [iframe_start, iframe_end]?' every fixed step. No setTimeout, no seconds comparison.
binding_rules.C2: I-frames grant HIT-NEGATION, not hitbox removal. The hurtbox continues to exist and be swept; the overlap is detected, IFRAME_NEGATE is emitted, and damage/poise/status are zeroed.
binding_rules.C3: A roll is uncancellable from press to the final recovery frame.
binding_rules.C4: Direction is latched at frame 1 and stick movement thereafter is ignored.
binding_rules.C5: Root motion is authoritative. The 5.20 m comes from the clip's root track, not from velocity * dt.
binding_rules.C6: Input buffer = 8 f@60 (133 ms), NOT rebased. Exactly one action buffers; a later press overwrites; an earlier press is DROPPED, not queued.
binding_rules.C7: Insufficient stamina drops the input. No partial roll, no queued roll, no debt.
binding_rules.C8: Equip load is evaluated once, at the frame of the press.

no_antispam_rule.statement: There is NO escalating penalty for consecutive rolls and adding one is a defect. The economy already punishes it.
